links.outcome: Adequacy and harmfulness of ChatGPT-4o antimicrobial therapy recommendations rated by independent infectious diseases specialists
links.effect: Optimal antimicrobial therapy 34%-66% for ChatGPT-4o vs 72%-86% for IDSs; inadequate 2%-18% vs 2%-8%; harmful 0%-14% vs 0%-2%; grader agreement moderate-low.
links.quote: The percentages of optimal antimicrobial therapy suggested by ChatGPT-4o were lower than those of IDSs (34%-66% vs. 72%-86%) and a trend towards lower adequacy was retrieved (inadequate 2%-18% vs. 2%-8%, harmful 0%-14% vs. 0%-2%), albeit the agreement between graders was moderate-low.

links.outcome: Management plan quality of ChatGPT-4o versus local infectious diseases specialists on the same patients
links.effect: Diagnoses identical to IDSs in ≥90% of cases; work-up appropriateness significantly lower than IDSs; optimal antimicrobial therapy 34%-66% vs 72%-86%.
links.quote: Despite low inadequacy (0%-12%), the appropriateness of work-up proposed by ChatGPT-4o was significantly lower than that of IDSs because it was not specific enough in almost half of cases.

screen.reason: Prospective cohort study comparing the clinical management and diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4o against infectious disease specialists using real patient clinical data, but not deployed in real-time care.
